attempt_summaries.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, securityContext with runAsNonRoot, non-zero runAsUser, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, dropped all capabilities, added CPU/memory requests and limits.

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalog
  namespace: shop
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalog
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalog
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: catalog
          image: ghcr.io/example/catalog:1.12.0
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_HOST
              value: postgres.shop.svc.cluster.local
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "128Mi"
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalog
  namespace: shop
spec:
  selector:
    app: catalog
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
